estimand: Type-I error and BH/BY FDR calibration under synthetic and empirically anchored nulls (N1-N4)
value_summary: Asymptotic item-clustered t passes all standard-N (N>=100) calibration gates (max Type-I 0.0539; N4b 80/20 partial-null global BH FDR 0.0510 on MMLU and 0.0401 on SLAB at >93% power; N=26 word_not_containing qualified at 0.0634). Pooled fixed-block RCBD fails calibration under empirical heteroscedasticity (27.1% Type-I on MMLU Factor C, 18.4% global BH FDR), so its 565 per-cube / 422 global rejections are withdrawn as variance-pooling artifacts. B=2000 sign-flip resolves global BH to 58 MMLU detections (corroborating clustered t's 52).
averaging_unit: 4,275 MMLU and 712 SLAB factor tests across 4 null/partial-null simulation and empirical bootstrap regimes
uncertainty_method: Monte Carlo standard errors + 95% binomial upper bounds against registered 0.065 gate
